category_risk.rule: This is a DIETARY SUPPLEMENT sold on cognitive effect ('Clean Energy & Calm Focus', 'Cognition Elixir'). Every ingredient, dose, mechanism or evidence claim is structure/function-claim territory, and the engine NEVER invents or derives one. Formulation claims enter ONLY as brand-approved written copy recorded via brand-asks (SOURCED_BY_BRAND). The brand's internal R&D systems are OUT OF SCOPE for this engine by operator directive 2026-08-09 — the engine does not connect to or query them.

'Prize With Every Can' is printed on the can — an on-pack promotion. Any video that shows the can shows a prize claim, which drags in the same sweepstakes-disclosure surface as Muha's giveaways. No official rules, odds, or disclosure requirements are recorded anywhere for it.
